verdict.rationale: A probe shows docs pages are served as agent-friendly Markdown (get-started.md returns HTTP 200), and those pages point to a complete documentation index for LLMs on the Mintlify-hosted site, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. However, the canonical graphite.com/llms.txt returns 404, so the llms index lives only on a third-party docs subdomain. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the canonical graphite.com root, first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.
